question: Digital India scheme was launched in which of the following years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2015**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Digital India is a program launched by the union government with the aim to transform India into a digitally empowered knowledge economy.
 
 
• The main objective of the Digital India scheme is to increase the internet and broadband connection in rural areas__.
 
• It was launched on 1st July 2015.
 
• Launched by Indian prime minister Narendra Modi.
 
• Power to empower is the Motto of the Digital India scheme.
 
 
 
• The objectives of the Digital India scheme are:
 
 
• Making cyberspace safe and secure.
 
• To improve the ease of doing business through transformed digital service.
 
• Universalization of digital literacy.
 
• To boost cashless digital transactions.
